_note: The rate the Rules state for a journey between places not connected by rail, where no recognised public transport system exists (D-100): Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.278(1)(iii)(B) (p.1776): "an amount calculated at the rate of ₹30 per kilometre, for the distance of the journey by the shortest route shall be admissible". TY 2026-27 only: Rules 1962 r.2B(1)(iii)(B) states no rate — "an amount equivalent to the air-conditioned first class rail fare … as if the journey had been performed by rail" — so for TY 2025-26 that fare is entered like any other. In every regime as a row; the new regime forbids it through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION, whose basis REG-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (S2 s.202(2)(a); 1961 s.115BAC(2)(i)) every explanation cites (D-166). The row reaches a journey between places not connected by rail, with no recognised public transport system, only (journey.mode = NOT_RAIL_CONNECTED_WITHOUT_PUBLIC_TRANSPORT): r.278(1)(iii)(B)'s "where no recognised public transport system exists" (W-156e, D-350).
